agPublicIpAddress.description: Application gateways public ip address. This will be used to login to the console.

consoleEndPoint.description: Url to the C3 console. E.g. https://52.232.229.203/console/

masterNodes.description: Domain names of the master nodes. E.g. ["dev-podc-app-m-01"]

workerNodes.description: Domain names of the worker nodes. E.g. ["dev-podc-app-w-001"]

zkNodes.description: Domain names of the zookeeper nodes. E.g. ["dev-podc-zk-01", "dev-podc-zk-02", "dev-podc-zk-03"]

cassNodes.description: Domain names of the cassandra nodes. E.g. ["dev-podc-cass-001", "dev-podc-cass-129", "dev-podc-cass-257"]

pgNodes.description: Domain names of the pg node(s). E.g. ["dev-podc-pg-01"]

bastionPublicIpAddress.description:
Public Ip address of the bastion node. This could be used to ssh into the bastion node for logging into any of the
other resources

package.description: The C3 server package that was deployed e.g. c3-server-development-7.9.2.11-1.x86_64.rpm
